title.narrative: Hybrid Threats in the Indo-Pacific ¿ Pilot Action (HIPPA)

description.narrative:
The launch in 2021 of the EU strategy for cooperation in the Indo-Pacific was an important milestone and has reframed the EU¿s approach to the region. Through its Indo-Pacific Strategy, the EU aims to promote a free and open Indo-Pacific, to reinforce respect of international law and address global challenges, as well as to contribute to the stability, security and prosperity of the region. The EU intends to strengthen partnerships with all relevant actors in the Indo-Pacific, taking into consideration sub-regional dynamics and specificities.

The Overall Objective of this Action is that inter-regional cooperation between the EU and Indo-Pacific partners against hybrid threats in the Indo-Pacific is advanced.

The Overall Objective of the Action is achieved through building upon Specific Outcomes (SO) and corresponding activities:

SO 1 is enhanced awareness and common understanding of hybrid threats in the Indo-Pacific among EU and Indo-Pacific partners.

·Activities for SO1: A mapping of hybrid threats landscape in the Indo-Pacific that captured main stakeholders, issues and gaps in assessing and addressing such threats. This mapping covered topics such as cyber, technology and national security, maritime coercion, information manipulation and interference operations that will be refined with consultation with regional partners.

SO 2 is strengthened abilities of EU and Indo-Pacific partners to address hybrid threats.

·Activities for SO2: A series of up-to six practitioner-level exchange activities, with a particular focus on learning, building capacity and expanding expertise of hybrid threats in the region. The exchanges could focus on geographical and thematic hybrid threats, skill development and analytical challenges that will be refined with consultation with regional partners. Subsequently, a series of two practitioner-level exchanges between Indo-Pacific and European like-minded partners to determine stakeholder willingness and requirements to establish a multistakeholder platform for cooperation and information exchange on hybrid threats.
